scientific_integrity: Exact proof supplied for all finite fields and all positive symplectic ranks; independent mathematical audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: The 2014 homogeneous-basis theorem and standard finite symplectic group counts are prior ingredients. Novelty concerns the embedded finite-field labelled-grading distribution, explicit orbit cardinalities and asymptotic central parity. An equivalent unindexed census cannot be excluded. Small-field exhaustive tests do not replace the full proof.
title: Exact labelled \(\mathbb Z/2\)-grading census of finite Heisenberg Lie algebras
